contexts.text: That the third cause of legitimate separation is impotence before marriage. Explained.
6. It is a law of order that man... should not stand in the faith of impotence, and wait...
They were all full of confirmations of man's utter impotence in spiritual things. TCR 630:2. TCR 647:7.
Ice succeeds, either with impotence, or with aversion...
Hence it is that the man feels impotence if the woman wills, and still more if she importunes...
The ultimate lot (of adulterers) is, that from the extreme impotence into which they at last reduce themselves, they become devoid of all the fire and light of life... DeConj 9:end.
He who abstains from adulteries (merely)... from impotence... is still an adulterer interiorly.
